changes_made: Added import: from django.views.decorators.cache import cache_page
Added @cache_page(300) decorator to dashboard() view function

patterns_discovered.observation: cache_page decorator applied above login_required decorator
patterns_discovered.implication: Cache will apply to entire response including authentication check

patterns_discovered.observation: 300 second (5 minute) cache TTL chosen for dashboard
patterns_discovered.implication: Dashboard data updates every 5 minutes; balance between performance and freshness

patterns_discovered.observation: Only cache_page imported, not other cache utilities
patterns_discovered.implication: Simple view-level caching strategy without granular cache control

gotchas_discovered.description: cache_page placed before login_required may cache authenticated responses and serve to unauthorized users
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Verify if login_required should be applied first to prevent serving cached authenticated data to unauthenticated users

gotchas_discovered.description: No cache invalidation logic present for when purchasing data is modified
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Implement cache clearing on create/update/delete operations in purchasing models

gotchas_discovered.description: cache_page only works with GET/HEAD requests; POST requests bypass cache
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Ensure dashboard view only handles GET requests if caching all response variants

approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Added Django's built-in view-level caching decorator to optimize dashboard view performance
approach_outcome.changes_summary: Minimal change: 1 import statement + 1 decorator application

recommendations.recommendation: Review decorator order - consider if @login_required should precede @cache_page to prevent caching user-specific data across sessions
Implement cache invalidation signals on PurchasingOrder, PurchasingItem, and related model save/delete operations
Add cache hit/miss metrics to monitor actual cache effectiveness on dashboard view
Add test cases verifying: cache behavior with login_required, cache TTL accuracy, cache invalidation on data changes
Document the 300-second cache duration rationale and any assumptions about data freshness requirements
